english.title: Carry out work known to be likely to affect operation of water meter or require its disconnection
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), without appropriate consent, carried out works which you knew were likely to affect the operation or required the disconnection of a meter used by a

(A)_[relevant undertaker]_
(B)_[water supply licensee]_
(C)_[sewerage licensee]_in determining the amount of charges fixed in relation to premises at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 175(1)(b) of the Water Industry Act 1991.
